meta.title: Master Dialog Standard & Single Active Editor Lifecycle
meta.subtitle: Phase 23.1 unified modal dialog, dirty state detection, switch coordination, and idempotent retry

views.label: Draft Editing & Modification
views.note: User opens Create or Edit dialog; in-memory state tracks pristine vs modified field status across all control types.

views.label: Switch Coordinator & Guard
views.note: Single active editor rule intercepts navigation or opening a new form; user confirms Keep or Discard.

views.label: Submission & Safe Retry
views.note: Idempotent submission key protects against double-submit; 422 errors keep draft data for zero-loss correction.

cards.title: Single Active Editor Architecture
items: useEditorCoordinator enforces maximum 1 active editor draft across all 60 pages / 92 files
Attempts to switch form or navigate back with unsaved changes trigger DiscardChangesDialog
User choice 'Keep' preserves draft in memory; 'Discard' resets cleanly and opens requested editor

cards.title: Comprehensive Dirty Detection
items: Tracks scalar inputs, dates, numbers, checkboxes, and barcode scanner inputs
Multi-warehouse, lot, and bin location pickers accurately detected on value change
Line items, indexed monetary values, and DMS file attachments tracked against initial state

cards.title: Idempotent Submission Protection
items: EnsureFormSubmission middleware records submission_key and sha256 fingerprint in form_submissions
Duplicate POST attempts return cached JSON receipt without duplicate database creation
HTTP 422 validation errors never consume submission key, preserving draft for immediate retry
